question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) AS year_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%'
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR)
),
monthly_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        year_month,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month_end_balance > 0) AS positive_customers_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY year_month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        year_month,
        positive_customers_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers_count DESC) AS rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers_count ASC) AS rn_asc
    FROM monthly_customer_counts
),
highest_lowest_months AS (
    SELECT year_month, positive_customers_count, rn_desc, rn_asc
    FROM ranked_months
    WHERE rn_desc = 1 OR rn_asc = 1
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        year_month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE year_month IN (
        SELECT year_month FROM ranked_months WHERE rn_desc = 1
        UNION
        SELECT year_month FROM ranked_months WHERE rn_asc = 1
    )
    GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
    hlm.year_month AS highest_month,
    hlm.positive_customers_count AS highest_positive_count,
    ab_high.avg_balance AS highest_avg,
    lhm.year_month AS lowest_month,
    lhm.positive_customers_count AS lowest_positive_count,
    ab_low.avg_balance AS lowest_avg,
    (SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) FROM monthly_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM ranked_months WHERE rn_desc = 1)) -
    (SELECT AVG(month_end_balance) FROM monthly_balances WHERE year_month = (SELECT year_month FROM ranked_months WHERE rn_asc = 1)) AS balance_difference
FROM highest_lowest_months hlm
JOIN avg_balances ab_high ON hlm.year_month = ab_high.year_month
JOIN highest_lowest_months lhm ON lhm.rn_desc < 2 OR lhm.rn_asc < 2
JOIN avg_balances ab_low ON lhm.year_month = ab_low.year_month
